top_call_exchanges.topic: Atera Commercial Launch Velocity & Instrument Capex Headwinds
top_call_exchanges.question: Can you describe the early customer uptake for Atera following the initial commercial shipments? Are researchers substituting existing Xenium placements or expanding into net new spatial budgets?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Serge Saxonov (CEO): 'Atera demand has been extraordinary. What we are seeing is not cannibalization of Xenium, but rather opening up high-throughput translational and biopharma programs that previously could not access subcellular spatial resolution at this scale. While broader instrument capital spending across academic labs remains constrained, Atera represents a must-have system for data-maximalist research.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: Gross Margin Resilience & Mix Progression Toward 75%
top_call_exchanges.question: Gross margin reached 74.95%, up nearly 765 basis points YoY. How sustainable is this mid-70s gross margin as Atera instrument volume ramps against consumables?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Justin McAnear (CFO): 'The gross margin strength this quarter was powered by lower inventory charges, manufacturing efficiency gains in our microfluidic consumables, and a 89% consumables revenue mix. Even as Atera instrument shipments ramp in Q4, the high consumable pull-through per installed instrument gives us confidence that our structural gross margins will remain firmly in the mid-70s.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: Sentira Cloud AI Platform & Monetization with NVIDIA / Claude
top_call_exchanges.question: How will Sentira be commercialized? Does the integration with NVIDIA accelerated computing and Anthropic Claude create a software ARR subscription stream?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Serge Saxonov (CEO): 'Sentira addresses the biggest bottleneck in biology today: extracting biological truth from massive, complex spatial datasets. By partnering with NVIDIA for accelerated spatial image processing and Anthropic for agentic Claude reasoning across single-cell multiomics, we are transforming 10x into an end-to-end biological intelligence platform. We will monetize Sentira through compute tiers and enterprise SaaS subscriptions.'
